title: Mutual information based weighted variance approach for uncertainty quantification of climate projections
author: Majhi, Dhanya, et al.

steps.title: Calculate Model Error
steps.instruction: Determine the model error (e) for the variable 'v' for each GCM by calculating the deviation of the model data from the reference observed data.

substeps.instruction: Average the model data from the historical period to obtain vxmodel.
Average the observational data from the historical period to obtain vobs.
Calculate error for each model x (where x varies from 1 to m) using the formula: ex = vobs - vxmodel.

steps.title: Estimate Mutual Information (MI)
steps.instruction: Estimate the mutual information between every possible pair of model error terms to measure the dependency between models.

substeps.instruction: For every pair of models (x, y), calculate MI(ex, ey) using the formula: MI(ex,ey) = ΣΣ p(ex,ey) log[p(ex,ey) / (p(ex)p(ey))], where p(ex,ey) is the joint probability mass function and p(ex), p(ey) are the marginal probability mass functions of the errors.

steps.title: Calculate Similitude Scores
steps.instruction: Estimate the degree of resemblance between each model pair (x and y) as a similitude score (Sxy).

substeps.instruction: Calculate the score using the formula: Sxy = e^-(1 / MI(ex,ey)^2).

steps.title: Determine Mutual Dependency Score
steps.instruction: Determine the mutual dependency (Dx) of a specific model x by aggregating its similitude with all other models in the ensemble.

substeps.instruction: Calculate the dependency score using the formula: Dx = 1 + Σ Sxy (where y varies from 1 to n, and y ≠ x).

steps.title: Calculate and Normalize Independence Weights
steps.instruction: Assign an independence weight (Wx) to each model based on its dependency score and normalize the weights.

substeps.instruction: Calculate the raw independence weight as the inverse of the dependency score: Wx = 1 / Dx.
Normalize the weights such that the sum of all weights equals 1 (Σ Wx = 1).

steps.title: Quantify Model Uncertainty
steps.instruction: Use the calculated independence weights to quantify the uncertainty among GCMs using a weighted variance approach.

substeps.instruction: Calculate the model uncertainty using the formula: Model uncertainty = [Σ Wx(vx - v_avg)^2 / Σ Wx]^(1/2), where vx is the variable from model x and v_avg is the average value of variable 'v' across all m models.
